messages:
mira: quick heads-up — opened a tiny hotfix PR to add the public status permalink and a short customer workaround for last night's model fallback. Need 1 reviewer and a green preview before the 11:00 customer sync.
evan: drop the PR link pls
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/721 — edits: add status.redwood.com permalink to /operational/incidents, Known issue note about KV-cache invalidation during autoscaler leader failover, short ops workaround, and JS/Python retry snippets.
sam: I can take the prose pass. note: CI link-checker has been strict with external permalinks lately.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #721 — build error: broken external link https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover (HTTP 404). See CI log.
sre_kim: correct public permalink is https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-followup — please update. Also add the detection query under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) by (model)
```
mira: updated the permalink and added the promql. pushed a fix.
deploy-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-721--docs.redwood.com — please verify the Known Issue render.
evan: LGTM, minor nit: Python snippet should use timeout_ms and explicit backoff. Suggest: `client.generate(model=\"redwood-7b\", prompt=\"...\", timeout_ms=90000, max_retries=4, backoff_ms=200)`
mira: updated snippet per evan and force-pushed.
support-lucy: can you add a one-line customer blurb under "Customer note" so support can copy it to KB? Suggest: "We experienced a brief model failover; please retry after 2 minutes and consult the incident page: <status link>."
mira: added the customer blurb and left a TODO for translations.
sam: staging smoke after promotion? @deploy-bot promote please.
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #721 — status: in-progress.
sam: quick smoke passed, no rendering issues. I approve.
merge-bot: All required approvals present for PR #721. Running final CI checks.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #721.
merge-bot: PR #721 merged into main by mira at 1779000540. Changelog entry queued; notifying #incidents to update timeline.
mira: thanks team — i'll open a backport PR to internal runbooks and follow up with a short postmortem note.
